advicePromo.heading: Test this campaign before you fund it
advicePromo.body: ADvice is our free AI campaign simulator. Paste your ad, pick the channel and budget, and it predicts your click-through rate, cost per click and cost per lead, scores the creative out of 100 and rewrites the copy. The first one needs no sign-up.
